message.content: They believed that he controlled the flow of wealth. We know that she, the queen, often managed her own assets. It is clear that they relied on their allies. You see that it affected them deeply. He traded with his neighbors, and she exchanged gifts with her rivals. They used their resources wisely. We must consider that it strengthened their rule. It gave him more power over his subjects. She ensured that her people had enough food. They built temples with their earnings. We think that it made them richer. It allowed him to expand his territory. She used her influence to secure better deals. They trusted their merchants completely. We observe that it changed their society. It helped him maintain order in his kingdom. She protected her trade routes from thieves. They shared their knowledge with others. We believe that it united their nation. It gave him a sense of pride. She celebrated her successes publicly. They remembered their ancestors’ legacy. We respect their historical impact.
